rules: Grayscale interface and text selection; theme swatches retain palette colors.
Supplied English and corresponding Chinese vocabulary use yellow fill and bold black text; annotations are red.
Forest theme uses a green circular swatch.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Account/export popovers and modal cards; CSS --shadow.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Control color/border transitions and press feedback.

motion.name: definition-focus
motion.purpose: Selected definition-word background fades to transparent.

contextTranslation.scope: The actual English example sentence containing the selected vocabulary and its single-sentence Chinese translation.
contextTranslation.savedTranslation: Reuse a valid saved paragraph translation only when the paragraph contains one English sentence.
contextTranslation.request: Authenticated POST /api/context/translation, loaded lazily for the selected definition; paragraph, paragraphTranslation and terms provide context.

sessionCache.requestDeduplication: An in-flight request map shares requests for the same payload and clears each entry on completion.
sessionCache.eviction: Remove the oldest inserted result when the cache exceeds 200 translations.

contextTranslation.status: A role=status region shows loading or unavailable state with a retry button; empty status and translation elements are hidden.
contextTranslation.highlights: Retain English vocabulary and aligned Chinese-term highlights; match overlapping Chinese terms once.

library.dateBasis: first addition (createdAt), displayed in browser local time
library.folders: create, rename, delete retaining articles, and move articles

notebook.disclosure: Separate 44px chevron button inside .study-controls on the mastery row; aria-expanded and aria-controls toggle a hidden details section.
notebook.delete: Visible and accepted only for mastered entries.
notebook.sourceAction: Open the saved source article snapshot and focus its target word; older entries fall back to matching favorites, then local history.
notebook.sourceStorage: sourceArticle JSON persists with local and cloud notebook entries and survives definition hydration.

calendar.sizeBehavior: Standard uses month navigation and 本月; thumbnail shows twelve months with year navigation and 今年. Size selection uses aria-pressed and persists as standard or mini under texta_calendar_size. Selecting an addition date opens its filtered list with return and clear-date controls, and stores the selected month so standard shows that month.
calendar.animationTargets: Standard calendar-grid and thumbnail calendar-year-grid use the shared grid transition; miniature inner grids do not animate separately. Reduced motion disables both grid targets and date markers.

components.description: Inline vocabulary control linked to the selected definition.
components.html: We can build a resilient community.

narrative.overview: The confirmed direction favors open space, clear study actions and visible links between vocabulary in the article and its selected definition. Interface copy names actions or explains actual state. Chinese is the default interface language with a persistent English switch; learning content keeps its own language.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral ground with sage action and selection colors.
Display serif for identity and English titles; Georgia for reading.
Broad content areas, quiet dividers and restrained controls.
Functional state changes with short motion and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Study State Rule
rules.body: Use sage to identify an action, selected study state or vocabulary relationship; carry meaning with text and state attributes as well as color.

rules.name: The Language Role Rule
rules.body: Keep display lettering, English reading and Chinese interface text in their assigned stacks. The interface-language toggle does not rewrite the article.

rules.name: The Reading Plane Rule
rules.body: Keep article paragraphs on the page plane. Use tonal containers for study support and ambient elevation for floating controls.

rules.name: The Export Document Rule
rules.body: Use the shared EXPORT_DOCUMENT_STYLES print layout for preview, PDF and Word. Article PDFs are a continuous single page; notebook exports contain only vocabulary, part of speech and Chinese meanings from the current filtered list. Keep mobile export menus within the reading toolbar bounds and route opened history articles to reading.

rules.name: The Independent Reading Rule
rules.body: Article and definition content scroll independently with hidden scrollbars and keyboard access. Keep toolbars visible, contain scroll at pane boundaries, preserve positions across mobile reading tabs and reset positions when a new article opens. PDF capture uses a separate fixed-width document so screen scrolling and mobile viewport offsets cannot crop its content.

rules.name: The Reading Space Rule
rules.body: After successful generation or opening an article, hide vocabulary input and generation settings to give article and definition panes the available viewport. Edit vocabulary opens a separate editor retaining words and settings; Back to article resumes the existing article and its reading position. A failed generation keeps the editor available. Mobile Input and Article navigation follows the same states.

rules.name: The Focus Reading Rule
rules.body: Collapse the article toolbar as content scrolls down and restore it at the top. Focus mode hides navigation and toolbars, announces ESC exit, and supplies a touch exit control. Highlighted words open a closable definition overlay without changing article position; background hydration never reopens it. Notebook content spans the entire study grid; bold list rows are the default; cards and a first-addition calendar with centered standard month and thumbnail annual views remain selectable. Unfamiliar/mastered categories preserve complete entries. Library pages hide the mobile reading navigation.

rules.name: The Persistent Export Controls Rule
rules.body: Keep export preview Close and Confirm Export in a visible header and footer while only the middle document scrolls. Hide routine success and article-open microcopy while retaining errors and active generation progress.

rules.name: The Library Organization Rule
rules.body: Notebook and favorites default to A–Z and offer first-added newest/oldest sorting and search. Notebook has unfamiliar/mastered categories and list/cards/calendar views. A separate chevron on the mastery row controls hidden details; only mastered entries offer deletion. Source actions open saved article snapshots and focus the word, with favorites/history fallback for older entries. Calendar offers a persistent standard month/thumbnail annual choice; the annual overview shows twelve aligned six-week months, month and year counts, responsive four/three/two/one columns and year navigation. Addition dates use fluorescent circles and open a date-filtered list; selecting a date retains its month for standard view. Reduced motion disables standard month, annual grid and marker animations. Favorites folders support create, rename, move and delete while retaining articles.

dos: **Do** preserve warm neutral, ink and sage as the default; optional palettes retain the same semantic roles and readable state cues.
**Do** use the display, reading and interface font roles for their documented purposes.
**Do** preserve generous reading space and collapse the study grid for narrow screens.
**Do** pair selected vocabulary, mastery and navigation colors with readable text and accessible state.
**Do** use direct functional copy in the current interface language and retain learning-content language.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: **Don't** add slogans, decorative microcopy or diagonal arrows.
**Don't** crowd the chosen study composition with a navigation sidebar or extra ornamental panels.
**Don't** turn prose paragraphs into a repeated field of raised cards.
**Don't** claim invented study statistics, testimonials, sentence translations or visual-fidelity approval.
